caption: The drawing depicts a stylized, symmetrical plant with a central, upright red stem. At the top center of the stem is a large, round, yellow flower with a fringed edge. Two large, tulip-shaped red flowers with yellow and green accents extend from both the upper left and right sides of the central stem. Lower down on both sides, three red flowers with yellow centers and green sepals branch outward. Numerous dark green, oval-shaped leaves extend from the main stem and from the flower-bearing branches. The central stem features a wavy green line running vertically with several small yellow dots along it. The drawing is set on a beige background, and all elements are outlined and filled with solid colors: red, yellow, green, and dark green. The composition is balanced and oriented vertically with mirrored elements on each side.
title: Drawing for Plate 7: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
